_comment: Illustrations de la page « Voici ton profil » de l'onboarding (une par objectif), même direction que les avatars (manifest-avatars-duels.json). Deux essais par objectif (a, b) ; celui retenu (cultivate b, curiosity a, exams a, impress b, reduce_screen b) est copié, en 480 px, en onboarding_profile_<objectif> dans ios/Sophia/Assets.xcassets et android/app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi.

items.name: onboarding_profile_cultivate_a
items.prompt: A stack of three thick books with a small sprouting plant growing out of the top book and a few small four-point stars around it. Flat poster illustration, paper-cut shapes, limited palette of deep navy blue, saffron yellow, coral red, cream, warm brown and tan, bold simple forms, subtle paper grain, plain cream paper background, single centered object, lots of empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no outlines.
